description: Search the grokbot.tools directory of MCP connectors and plugins for Grok Bot by name, service or category, with optional filters (Grok Bot test status, install method, auth type). Returns compact summaries with the install method, auth type, honest test-status label and the grokbot.tools page URL; use get_connector for install steps and the MCP URL. Only published directory entries are returned. Read-only; independent fan project, not affiliated with xAI.

auth_type.description: 'oauth' = you sign in with your own account; 'public' = no sign-in.

category.description: Exact category name, case-insensitive, e.g. 'Developer tools & data', 'Money', 'Design', 'Docs & search', 'Projects & docs', 'Sales & support', 'Files', 'Security'. Use list_connectors with no filters to see categories in use.

install_method.description: How the app gets into Grok Bot: built-in plugin (Connect apps), custom MCP URL added via chat, browser only, or unverified.

limit.description: Max results, 1-25 (default 10). Larger values are clamped to 25.

query.description: Free text matched against connector name, service, category and slug, e.g. 'notion' or 'payments'.

status.description: Grok Bot test status. 'verified' = dated test inside Grok Bot. 'seen_working' = seen working, dated re-test pending. 'unknown' = not re-tested inside Grok Bot yet (includes seen_working). 'broken' = failed when tried.

name: search_connectors
title: Search Grok Bot connectors
